arguments.title: Falcon Distribution — Investment & Sales Offering Memorandum
arguments.subtitle: Industrial · Indianapolis, IN · As of 2026-08-31 · Original fictional evaluation material

sections.heading: Executive Summary
paragraphs: Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence.

Falcon Distribution is an 8-suite industrial asset totaling 176,060 SF in Indianapolis. Seven suites are physically occupied (154,060 SF) and one suite (008) is vacant on the manager's certified rent roll dated 2026-08-31. The manager's cover characterizes occupancy as 7 of 8 by including pending occupants that have not taken possession; the certified detail controls physical occupancy at 7 of 8 active only if suite 008 is treated as vacant. Certified detail governs.

Prescribed underwriting produces EGI of $1,335,320, NOI (before reserves) of $902,476 and NCF of $900,076. Capitalized at 6.2500%, gross value indication is $14,439,622. Sized on the 7.00% floor (greater of note rate 6.10% and floor 7.00%) at 30-year amortization with 1.25x DSCR / 9% NCF debt yield / 65% LTV, the DSCR test binds at approximately $9,019,220. After 1% origination, $45,000 of closing costs and a $7,800,000 existing payoff, net cash-out to the sponsor is approximately $1,084,027.
Photos, asking price, market sales and rent comparables, and sponsor history are not included in the packet and have not been inferred.

sections.heading: Property & Suite Mix
paragraphs: Manager group mapping (A/B/C) corresponds in order to Small suite, Standard suite, Large suite.

sections.heading: Rent Roll & Occupancy (certified, 2026-08-31)
paragraphs: Suite 008 is the only vacant suite on the certified roll. Physical unit occupancy is 7/8 = 0.8750; area occupancy is 154,060 / 176,060 = 0.8750. The manager's headline of 7 of 8 improperly counts pending (unpossessed) occupants as leased.

sections.heading: Historical vs Underwritten Financials
paragraphs: Historical figures come from operating-statement.pdf T12 ending 2026-08-31. Historical NOI ($869,736) reflects cash collections; underwritten NOI is a stabilized, definitionally different measure. NCF is NOI net of $2,400 reserves ($300 × 8 units).

sections.heading: Debt Sizing & Sources / Uses
paragraphs: Sizing rate is the greater of the 6.10% note rate and the 7.00% underwriting floor, so 7.00%; sized on a 30-year amortizing constant despite the first 24 months being interest-only. Constraints: 65% LTV of capitalized value ($9,385,755), 1.25x DSCR on NCF ($9,019,220), 9% NCF debt yield ($10,000,849). DSCR binds.

sections.heading: Risks & Missing Diligence
paragraphs: Present risks: (1) manager includes pending, unpossessed units in occupancy headline; (2) manager's historical ledger appears to be clean of capital-in-opex — the roof replacement is booked separately as capital, not in repairs, so the recurring-expense line does not embed a capital cost — this specific risk is therefore absent as reported.

Unresolved/absent risks: near-term rollover is absent because all leases expire 2029-08-31, beyond a 12-month horizon; unsigned rent change is absent because no unsigned rent proposal is included in the packet (lease-correspondence.pdf confirms no amendments affecting suite 001); temporary free rent is absent per lease-001.pdf; sizing floor binding is present because the 7.00% floor exceeds the 6.10% note rate; refinance shortfall is absent (net cash-out is positive $1,084,027); missing insurance is absent — insurance.pdf provides GL policy declaration.
Missing diligence explicitly not supplied: photos, asking price, market sales/rent comps, sponsor history, legal/environmental/property-condition/title reports (routine pending).

sections.heading: Source Notes
paragraphs: rent-roll-certified.xlsx (controlling, 2026-08-31); rent-roll-archive.xlsx (stale, 2026-06-30, retained for reference only); lease-001.pdf; lease-correspondence.pdf (confirms no amendments affecting suite 001); insurance.pdf (GL aggregate $2,000,000); operating-statement.pdf (T12 through 2026-08-31); underwriting-instructions.pdf; manager-cover.pdf; diligence-status.pdf.
